goal: Make every dod-guard skill operate on an OpenSpec change id and fetch artifact rules at runtime instead of carrying its own copies

steps.title: Write the skill hygiene guard
steps.description: Write scripts/ci/check-skill-hygiene.mjs with the rules no-step-session, plan-home, no-authoring-copy, no-legacy-fallback, change-scoped, dod-instruction, schema-steps-deps, interview-fetches, closing-gate and refactor-skip-specs. Each is selectable with --rule=<name>; with no flag every rule runs. It takes --root=<dir> so a test can point it at a fixture tree. Exit 0 when the selected rules pass, 1 when any fails with a message naming the file and the offending text, 3 on an unknown rule name. Zero dependencies, matching the other scripts in that directory. Write scripts/ci/check-skill-hygiene.test.mjs alongside it: every rule gets a fixture that violates it and a fixture that satisfies it, because a rule that cannot fail is the failure mode this guards against.

steps.title: Add the guard to the plugin-config CI job
steps.description: Add a step running node scripts/ci/check-skill-hygiene.mjs to the plugin-config job in .github/workflows/npm-publish.yml, next to validate-plugins.mjs and check-trace.mjs. Update the gate table in the root CLAUDE.md in the same step.

steps.title: A removed requirement produces no proof
steps.description: Teach extractRequirementBlocks in packages/dod-guard/src/openspec/requirements.ts to track the ## ADDED / ## MODIFIED / ## REMOVED / ## RENAMED headings. A requirement under ## REMOVED Requirements produces no block, so it reaches neither a group nor a leaf. Cover it in a new packages/dod-guard/src/openspec/delta-sections.test.ts.

steps.title: A leaf keeps its scenario name through render and parse
steps.description: Render a concrete leaf's title in packages/dod-guard/src/author.ts and read it back in src/parser.ts, replacing the title: desc fallback at parser.ts lines 56 and 67. The rendered form must stay parseable by the existing metadata comment scheme. Cover render, parse and the round trip in a new packages/dod-guard/src/title-round-trip.test.ts.

steps.title: Regeneration refreshes a leaf title
steps.description: Give dod_amend a new_title parameter and pass it from amendChangedLeaf in packages/dod-guard/src/openspec/regenerate-dod.ts, so a regenerated leaf never keeps a title from a scenario version that no longer exists. Extend title-round-trip.test.ts with the regeneration case. Update packages/dod-guard/docs/ for the rendered title and the new amend parameter.

steps.title: Fill the dod artifact instruction
steps.description: Replace the dod artifact's placeholder instruction in openspec/schemas/dod-guard-spec-driven/schema.yaml with the authoring policy currently in the interview skill: the predicate table, the category table, the timeout_ms rule, the regex-for-an-unwritten-test rule, the company baseline procedure reading standards/dod-baselines.md and standards/language-commands.md, the integration proof pair, the MANUAL: inspection leaf triggers, the test-first leaf pair, and the rule that a scenario's THEN line carries the proving command. State that dod_generate produces the document and that dod_amend, dod_refine and dod_add_node are the only ways to change it.

steps.title: Unblock steps on tasks and point it at the command
steps.description: Change the steps artifact's requires from [dod] to [tasks] in openspec/schemas/dod-guard-spec-driven/schema.yaml, and rewrite its instruction to run dod-guard steps <change-id> for the skeleton and then fill files and verify_surface by judgment. A change with no dod.md derives its steps from tasks.md. Make templates/steps.json the one authoritative field list.

steps.title: fetchInstructions takes an artifact id
steps.description: Give fetchInstructions in packages/dod-guard/src/openspec/fetch-instructions.ts an artifact id parameter in place of the hardcoded dod, so the steps subcommand can resolve its own output path. Update the existing caller and its tests.

steps.title: Add the dod-guard steps subcommand
steps.description: Add dod-guard steps <change-id> to packages/dod-guard/src/cli.ts. It loads the DoD registered for that change, calls dodTreeToSteps, wraps the array with goal, cwd, plan_source set to the change id and plan_artifacts from openspec status --json --change <id>, and writes the file at the path fetchInstructions resolves for the steps artifact. Exit 0 when written, 3 when the change has no registered DoD or the invocation is malformed, matching trace. Cover it in a new packages/dod-guard/src/openspec/steps-cli.test.ts.

steps.title: Cut the interview skill down to choreography
steps.description: In packages/dod-guard/skills/interview/SKILL.md delete the spec-delta tutorial, the predicate table, the category table, and the Company baseline, Integration proof, Human judgement and Test-first subsections. Section 5 becomes: propose the change, then run openspec instructions dod --change <id> and follow what it returns. Delete the dod_create fallback, the docs/plans/ path, and the note claiming dod_generate is not reachable in the deployed plugin. Keep the no-code gate, the research pass with its lint and format counts, the question floors and risk labels, the confirmed summary, the confirmed-versus-unconfirmed split, the five-lens review, the pre-code dod_check baseline, and the handoff table.
steps.verify_cmd: node scripts/ci/check-skill-hygiene.mjs --rule=interview-fetches && node scripts/ci/check-skill-hygiene.mjs --rule=no-authoring-copy && node scripts/ci/validate-plugins.mjs

steps.title: Move the executor onto the change directory
steps.description: In packages/dod-guard/skills/step-by-step/SKILL.md make openspec/changes/<id>/steps.json the only plan home. Delete the .step-session/ session directory, progress.log, plan-file sessions and the mtime staleness branch. Staleness is the plan_artifacts versus openspec status --json comparison. Delete the Persistence field list and point at openspec instructions steps --change <id>. Keep both the steps.json status field and the tasks.md checkbox, and state in one sentence that a checkbox cannot distinguish blocked from skipped. Keep the dod-guard trace then openspec archive finish.

steps.title: Strip cheap-step's session file references
steps.description: In packages/dod-guard/skills/cheap-step/SKILL.md remove every .step-session and progress.log reference, including the argument-hint. The rule that a settled ambiguity is written into the step description survives; the rule that it is appended to progress.log does not.

steps.title: Move quality-refactor onto a change
steps.description: In packages/quality-guard/skills/quality-refactor/SKILL.md open an OpenSpec change in Phase 0 and set skip_specs: true in its .openspec.yaml. Waves go to openspec/changes/<id>/tasks.md, the step plan to that change's steps.json, and the public-API and file-layout judgment to its design.md. Delete the inline steps.json literal and every field rule around it, pointing at openspec instructions steps --change <id> instead. .quality/units.json stays as regenerable scanner output.
steps.verify_cmd: node scripts/ci/check-skill-hygiene.mjs --rule=refactor-skip-specs && node scripts/ci/check-skill-hygiene.mjs --rule=no-step-session && node scripts/ci/validate-plugins.mjs

steps.title: Give ratchet a change id and the closing gate
steps.description: In packages/dod-guard/skills/ratchet/SKILL.md take a change id and resolve the dod_id from it. Fix the claim that /interview owns dod_create; it writes an OpenSpec change and generates the DoD from it. Tick the matching tasks.md line as each sub-problem's subtree passes. Finish with dod-guard trace <change-id> then openspec archive <change-id> --yes, stopping before archive on a non-zero trace.
steps.verify_cmd: node scripts/ci/check-skill-hygiene.mjs --rule=closing-gate && node scripts/ci/check-skill-hygiene.mjs --rule=no-legacy-fallback && node scripts/ci/validate-plugins.mjs

steps.title: Give adversarial-workflow a change id and the closing gate
steps.description: In packages/dod-guard/skills/adversarial-workflow/SKILL.md take a change id and resolve the dod_id from it. Fix the claim that /interview calls dod_create. Close phase 4 with dod-guard trace <change-id> then openspec archive <change-id> --yes.
steps.verify_cmd: node scripts/ci/check-skill-hygiene.mjs --rule=closing-gate && node scripts/ci/check-skill-hygiene.mjs --rule=change-scoped && node scripts/ci/validate-plugins.mjs

steps.title: Make the rewrite contract a spec delta
steps.description: In packages/dod-guard/skills/blind-rewrite/SKILL.md write the contract for a shape A, B or C target as the change's spec delta under openspec/changes/<id>/specs/, before deletion rather than as an optional Phase 9 write-back. .blind/ holds only the quarantined original, which is the mechanism the skill exists for. Fix the RFC 2119 contradiction: name SHALL and MUST and avoid should and may, matching the specs artifact instruction.

steps.title: Make each tighten target a change
steps.description: In packages/dod-guard/skills/tighten/SKILL.md open a change for each picked target before any rewrite starts. .tighten/ledger.json stays the scanner queue, and its statuses stop being a second completion vocabulary: a target is accepted when its change archives.

steps.title: Drop the dod_create reference from test-integrity-checker
steps.description: packages/dod-guard/skills/test-integrity-checker/SKILL.md still names dod_create. Replace it with the current path: the DoD is generated from the change's spec deltas. The guard found this skill; the plan had missed it.

steps.title: Retire the session directory
steps.description: Remove .step-session/ from .gitignore, from the IGNORED_DIRS set in scripts/ci/lib/fs-utils.mjs, and from packages/quality-guard/skills/quality-refactor/scripts/lib/config.mjs.

steps.title: Update the docs for the new plan home and subcommand
steps.description: Update packages/dod-guard/README.md, packages/dod-guard/USAGE.md and packages/dod-guard/CLAUDE.md for the change-directory plan home and the steps subcommand, and the root CLAUDE.md CLI table. Remove every remaining .step-session and docs/plans reference from shipped docs.

steps.title: Confirm the manual leaves
steps.description: Walk the MANUAL: draft leaves with the user: a blocked step keeping its tasks.md line unticked, a refactor change reaching the steps artifact with no spec deltas, the blind-rewrite contract landing under the change, a tighten target opening a change, and the dod instruction forbidding a hand-edited dod.md.
